gloss: to see through; to foresee; to see all the way

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {見通|みとお}しませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {見通|みとお}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {見通|みとお}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to see through; to see all the way to the end
definitions.explanation: To be able to see from one point to a distant point without obstruction. Used for long straight roads, clear views, etc.

definitions.gloss: to foresee; to predict; to see through (a plan or intention)
definitions.explanation: To anticipate a future outcome or to perceive someone's hidden intentions or the true nature of a situation.

examples.japanese: {真|ま}っすぐな⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{遠|とお}く⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{見通|みとお}せる。
examples.english: You can see all the way down the straight road.

examples.japanese: ⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濃|こ}くて→濃い：02344_koi⟧⟦{前方|ぜんぽう}→前方：19125_zenpou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{見通|みとお}せない。
examples.english: The fog is so thick that I can't see ahead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よければ→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}こう⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{見通|みとお}すこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: On a clear day, you can see all the way across the ocean.

⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見通|みとお}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: She had accurately foreseen the market movements.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧すべてお⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧だった。
examples.english: The teacher saw through all of the student's lies.

notes:
{見通|みとお}す has both a literal meaning (seeing through to the end of something) and a figurative meaning (foreseeing or seeing through deception).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)

ASPECT (ている):
{見通|みとお}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state of having foreseen or seen through something.

NOUN FORM — {見通|みとお}し:
The noun form means 'outlook' or 'prospect' and is extremely common:
- ⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧: the outlook is bright
- ⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧: the outlook is grim
- ⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}たない→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: no prospect in sight
- ⟦{見通|みとお}し→見通し：10566_mitooshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧: the forecast is too optimistic

COMMON PATTERNS:
